title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-21
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Beautiful soundboard recording highlighted by a stellar second‑set featuring China Cat > I Know You Rider, Good Lovin' and Ripple.
ai_review.review: The fans rave about the crystal‑clear soundboard source, calling it the best or “beautiful” capture of this concert. Musically the show shines in the second set – Bob’s coyote howl intro to a tight China Cat > I Know You Rider segue and a grooving Good Lovin' that even survives Pigpen’s slip‑up on Easy Wind, capped off by a sweet Ripple. While some note the first set is uneven and the jams modest, the overall vibe is positive and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and recording quality drive a strong rating; the few lower notes are outweighed by the positive consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Repeated praise for the recording as "beautiful" and "best of this show"; no complaints about dropouts or muddiness, indicating a clean, well‑balanced soundboard capture.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set opens with Bob urging the crowd to howl like a coyote, then launches into a tight China Cat > I Know You Rider; the set maintains momentum through a solid Good Lovin' and ends on a mellow Ripple.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir famously asks the audience to howl like a coyote before the China Cat > I Know You Rider segment.
